changelog: Introduced the Bluebird App Store with support for installing custom HTML, CSS, and JavaScript apps.
Added web app installation directly from a URL.
Added live wallpapers, desktop animations, and refresh effects.
Introduced Bluebird Word Impress, a new word-processing application.
Added toast notifications and improved system notification features.
Enhanced the media player with improved controls, lock-screen controls, and background playback persistence.
Fixed multiple File Explorer and desktop integration issues and unified file operations across both environments.
Improved app stability, performance, responsiveness, and overall system reliability.
Polished the Bluebird interface and improved the overall user experience.
